what: Helpers for Running the Forest Vegetation Simulator
title: Helpers for Running the Forest Vegetation Simulator
text: package provides well-documented set tools designed facilitate running Forest Vegetation Simulator, including tools processing Forest Inventory Analysis (FIA) data FVS-ready formats.

title: Helpers for Running the Forest Vegetation Simulator
text: package primarily intended streamline use FIA data FVS, make easier replicate runs, reduce amount work required many FVS runs small tweaks (one might need simulation experiment).

title: Helpers for Running the Forest Vegetation Simulator
text: Download state-level FIA data FIA datamart website. Subset data stands interest using dplyr-style filter statements fetch_cond() followed get_FIA_state(). Write keyword file specifying simulation parameters using one two built-functions: write_FVS_key() (single stand) write_multistand_key() (multiple stands). Run FVS desired variant using run_FVS(). Retrieve outputs resulting output (SQL .db file default, .xlsx .xls outputs may also requested).

title: Helpers for Running the Forest Vegetation Simulator
text: rFVSIEtools requires user FVS machine. relatively straightforward Windows, program can downloaded FVS website built using make following instructions FVS GitHub. what: Write an FVS Keyword file. — write_FVS_key
title: Write an FVS Keyword file. — write_FVS_key
text: Given simulation parameters file paths, function writes .key file can used control FVS simulation. Automatic formatting supported variety keywords; additional keywords may passed must formatted according FVS Keyword guide. Default simulation parameters (cycle length, number years, calibration, etc) designed match FVS GUI defaults specified Essential FVS, except outputs automatically written SQLite database. default, keyword file specifies simulation : Simulation results output SQLite database called FVSOut.db working directory. Cycles 10 years length. simulation run 100 years total. Self-calibration turned (see Essential FVS section 6.4 details). Missing heights dubbed using height-diameter relationships input data. Tripling turned (see Essential FVS p. 156 details). regeneration establishment model turned (see Essential FVS section 5.4 details).

title: Write an FVS Keyword file. — write_FVS_key
code: write_FVS_key(   out_dir = getwd(),   file_prefix,   database,   STDIDENT = NULL,   n_years = 100,   CYCLEAT = NULL,   calibrate = TRUE,   htd_reg = TRUE,   triple = TRUE,   add_regen = TRUE,   carbon_report = FALSE,   estab_keywords = NULL,   ffe_keywords = NULL,   random_seed = NULL,   db_tables = NULL,   READCORD = NULL,   READCORH = NULL,   READCORR = NULL,   additionals = NULL )

title: Write an FVS Keyword file. — write_FVS_key
text: out_dir character string specifying directory keyword file FVS output. Defaults working directory. file_prefix character string giving keyword file name go '.key' extension. database character string specifying full file path input SQLite database. STDIDENT Optional character string specifying stand identity. NULL (default) multistand projections; see GOOD VIGNETTE n_years Integer specifying number years future project. Default 100. CYCLEAT Optional integer specifying additional years add cycles. Useful getting stand/tree information specific years. calibrate Logical. self-calibration (TRUE, default) turned simulation (FALSE)? htd_reg Logical. missing heights dubbed using heights data (TRUE, default) using regional defaults (FALSE)? triple Logical. tree records split three identical records whose TPA sums original tree TPA order stabilize estimates small stands (TRUE, default) (FALSE)? add_regen Logical. regeneration/establishment model associated variant used (TRUE, default) turned (FALSE)? carbon_report Logical. Fire Fuels extension carbon report generated (TRUE) (FALSE, default)? estab_keywords Optional character vector keywords control regeneration/establishment model (see Essential FVS 5.4). element vector (string one keyword passed) must formatted according FVS keyword guide. ffe_keywords Optional character vector keywords pass Fire Fuels Extension. element vector (string one keyword passed) must formatted according FVS keyword guide. random_seed Optional odd integer reseed random number generator base FVS model. Useful reproducible simulation results. db_tables Optional character vector keywords request additional output tables. READCORD Optional numeric vector multipliers large tree diameter growth model. length order vector must correspond species FVS variant order multipliers apply correctly. See Essential FVS 6.5.2.2. READCORH Optional numeric vector multipliers large tree height growth model. length order vector must correspond species FVS variant order multipliers apply correctly. See Essential FVS 6.5.2.2. READCORR Optional numeric vector multipliers small tree height growth model. length order vector must correspond species FVS variant order multipliers apply correctly. See Essential FVS 6.5.2.2. additionals Optional character vector additional keywords. element must formatted according FVS keyword guide.

Default shared simulation parameters match FVS GUI except outputs automatically written external file. default, shared keyword file specifies simulation : Simulation results output SQLite database called FVSOut.db working directory. Cycles 10 years length. simulation run 100 years total. Self-calibration turned (see Essential FVS section 6.4 details). Missing heights dubbed using height-diameter relationships input data.
